whyMatters.en: Queens, NYC punk band formed in 1974. Short songs, few chords, and Johnny Ramone’s downstroke guitar on early Sire albums set a clear US punk timing reference.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约皇后区朋克乐队，1974 年成立。短歌、少和弦，以及 Johnny Ramone 在早期 Sire 专辑上的下行扫弦，构成清楚的美国朋克时值参照。

note.en: 1-2-3-4 count-in; downstroke guitar; under three minutes.
note.zh: 1-2-3-4 起拍；下行扫弦吉他；不到三分钟。

note.en: From Rocket to Russia; pop melody at high punk tempo.
note.zh: 出自《Rocket to Russia》；高朋克速度下的流行旋律。

note.en: Marky-era Road to Ruin; still short-song form.
note.zh: Marky 时期《Road to Ruin》；仍是短歌形式。

interviewQuotes.text: I don't play leads. I don't want to play leads.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Johnny Ramone

shortBio.en: Queens punk, 1974–96. Joey, Johnny, Dee Dee; Tommy then Marky on drums. Blitzkrieg Bop is the core timing reference.
shortBio.zh: 皇后区朋克，1974–96。Joey、Johnny、Dee Dee；鼓手先后为 Tommy 与 Marky。《Blitzkrieg Bop》是主要时值参照。

body.en: Forest Hills, New York, 1974–1996. John Cummings, Doug Colvin, and Jeffry Hyman took the Ramone surname from Paul McCartney’s Paul Ramon alias. CBGB residency built the leather-jacket look. Sex Pistols watched their 1976 UK dates; Springsteen wrote Hungry Heart for them then kept it. Sire’s early roster path also led toward Talking Heads and The Cure.
body.zh: 纽约森林山，1974–1996。John Cummings、Doug Colvin、Jeffry Hyman 的 Ramone 姓氏取自 Paul McCartney 的化名 Paul Ramon。CBGB 驻演固定皮夹克形象。Sex Pistols 看过他们 1976 年英国场次；Springsteen 曾为他们写《Hungry Heart》后又留给自己。Sire 早期厂牌路径也通向 Talking Heads 与 The Cure。

body.en: Short songs, downstroke guitar, 1-2-3-4 count-ins. The book places their reach from Sex Pistols to Springsteen, and later tribute guests from U2 to Metallica.
body.zh: 短歌、下行扫弦、1-2-3-4 预备拍。书中把影响范围写到 Sex Pistols 与 Springsteen，后来的致敬嘉宾从 U2 到 Metallica。

body.en: Tommy then Marky, with Richie in between. Clem Burke (Blondie) filled two shows as Elvis Ramone before Marky returned sober for Halfway to Sanity (1987).
body.zh: 鼓手从 Tommy 到 Marky，中间有 Richie。Blondie 的 Clem Burke 曾以 Elvis Ramone 名义顶两场，随后戒酒的 Marky 回归录《Halfway to Sanity》（1987）。

body.en: Blitzkrieg Bop and the early Sire debut fixed the template. Sheena Is a Punk Rocker leaned Beach Boys and reached the UK Top 30. Rocket to Russia (1977) held Rockaway Beach and Teenage Lobotomy.
body.zh: 《Blitzkrieg Bop》与 Sire 首专定下模板。《Sheena Is a Punk Rocker》偏 Beach Boys 味道并进入英国榜前 30。《Rocket to Russia》（1977）含《Rockaway Beach》与《Teenage Lobotomy》。

body.en:
Joey: tall deadpan lead vocal. Johnny: Mosrite and downstroke method; few solos by choice. Dee Dee: bass, many early lyrics, and count-ins.

The playing method is fixed and repeated rather than jam-based.
body.zh:
Joey：高个、冷脸主唱。Johnny：Mosrite 与下行扫弦方法；原则上很少独奏。Dee Dee：贝斯、许多早期歌词与起拍。

演奏方法固定、反复，而非即兴为主。

body.en:
Joey’s “We're a happy family” refrain and Johnny’s “I don't play leads” line document image and technique. Read them against the Sire tracking speeds.

The quotes match the short-song method on record.
body.zh:
Joey 的「We're a happy family」口头禅与 Johnny 的「I don't play leads」记录形象与技术。对照 Sire 跟录速度阅读。

引语与唱片上的短歌方法一致。

title.zh: 英国朋克与 hardcore 时值

body.en: CBGB linked them to the same New York room as Talking Heads’ early support slots. UK 1976 dates fed Sex Pistols’ sense that volume and attitude were enough.
body.zh: CBGB 把他们与 Talking Heads 早期暖场放在同一纽约场地。1976 年英国场次强化了 Sex Pistols 对音量与态度的判断。

note.en: Debut Ramones (1976) cost about $6,000. 4 July 1976 Roundhouse, London, with Flamin’ Groovies and The Stranglers; Johnny Rotten told them you didn’t need to be great—just play.
note.zh: 首专《Ramones》（1976）制作费约 6000 美元。1976 年 7 月 4 日伦敦 Roundhouse，与 Flamin’ Groovies、The Stranglers 同台；Johnny Rotten 说不必多厉害，出来演奏就行。

note.en: Tommy left touring 1978 but produced. Marky → Richie; Blondie’s Clem Burke briefly as Elvis Ramone. End of the Century with Phil Spector; Pleasant Dreams with 10cc’s Graham Gouldman. Final Lollapalooza 1996 show with guests including Motörhead’s Lemmy.
note.zh: Tommy 1978 年不再巡演但仍制作。Marky 之后是 Richie；Blondie 的 Clem Burke 曾短暂化名 Elvis Ramone 顶替。Phil Spector 制作《End of the Century》；10cc 的 Graham Gouldman 制作《Pleasant Dreams》。1996 年 Lollapalooza 末场嘉宾包括 Motörhead 的 Lemmy。

note.en: Count-in and downstroke guitar as a US punk timing reference.
note.zh: 起拍与下行扫弦吉他，作为美国朋克时值参照。

note.en: Short songs, few chords, high tempo.
